companyAnnouncements: ts-launch-blueprint: a production-ready TypeScript project template ported from py-launch-blueprint, shipping the ts-projects example CLI plus full quality gates. Commands: just all (format-check, lint, typecheck, test), just check-deps (toolchain check), just debug-info (environment report), just docs-check (README/docs link check), just pack-check (validate the packaged npm distribution), just pre-commit-run (hook suite on all files), just setup-hooks (git hooks + commit template). See AGENTS.md for the project charter, docs/port/ for the port process record, and the Justfile for all recipes.
